description: Reviewed supplier statements about co-component requirements. quote: the supplier wording exactly as printed. review: the explicit reviewed assessment that requirements.explicit_none_required needs: reviewed_on, meaning, unconditional (true/false), qualification_verbatim (the supplier's qualification as printed; '' only if unconditional), scope (component_types and routes: 'all' or a list) and conditions_verbatim. A statement makes the product-level requirement met only if it is for this product, its reviewed meaning is 'no_co_component_required', it is unconditional, and it covers all component types and all routes. A missing field proves nothing. An empty record is never recorded here as supplier silence.

statements.quote: HiTEC® 12210 already contains a pour point depressant (PPD) so no supplemental PPD should be needed to meet low temperature properties.
statements.conditions: as printed: for the package's listed API CK-4 / FA-4 grades; says nothing about a viscosity modifier or booster

routes: the API CK-4 and API FA-4 grades listed with the statement

review.note: The supplier says the package already contains a PPD 'so no supplemental PPD should be needed'. This is a qualified expectation about one component type. It says nothing about a viscosity modifier, which the same page names.
